## IntroDuction and infomation

This is an R Markdown document And an Introduction for my Package. This was package was created across the semester and was used to complete labes and store methods that can be used for later, If the requirment would ever happent to show up. Furtheremore this package also contains the FIREDAM.CSV Data set along with documenation for Stats methods and the data set. 

There is about 8 methods, however, This document will only highlight 4.

## computeTs.RD

This RD file computes The TSS (Total sum of squares)of Data set, and returns A numeric vector which represents the Total sum of squares.

```{r TSS}
fire <- read.csv("FIREDAM.csv")

library(MATH4753JASON)

computeTS(fire,1)


```


## LOGBINOMAL

This method finds the Log-Likelihood Function for the Binomial Distribution and computes the log-likelihood for a binomial random variable with a fixed size of 10 and a given probability parameter.

This also returns a Numeric vector containing log likehood values
```{r Log bin}

logbin(10,0.5)


```


## myncurve function

My ncruve functions computes the area of curve, given three Params, the mean, SD or simga, and Doh the value up to which the area under the curve.
the function returns the list of means  and sigma that can used.

```{r myncurve}

myncurve(mu = 100, sigma = 15, doh = 120)

```

## Hypergeo

this function produces a HYPERGEOMETRIC simulation and simulates repeated samples from a hypergeometric distribution. Where N is the population size, where R is The number of success states in the population and where n is the sample size. This returns a barplot of values

```{r hypergeo}

myhyper(iter = 1000,50,20,10)
```

## DATA SET

The only data set that was used in this package was the FIREDAM Dataset, This included two vars which were FIRE DAMAGE in thousands, and their distance from the nearest fire station. This study is made up from 15 random samples from a city.

```{r}
head(fire)

summary(fire)

```
